BiblicalUsage: Kenan is the son of Enosh, who lived ninety years and begat him, and the chronicler lists him again at the head of the line: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered. A name in the genealogy, holding the line between Adam and Noah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the quiet names in the genealogy are the spine of the story, because through Kenan the line runs to Noah and to Christ.
